object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Open the Properties dialog and close it without typing; then type a title, do not apply, and close it, answering Apply, Discard and Cancel in turn. Expected: no question when nothing was typed; otherwise one question; Apply writes the title and closes, Discard closes without writing, Cancel keeps the dialog open and writes nothing.
